blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Typhoon Cempaka, which is expected to enter the Philippine area of responsibility (PAR) on Monday and will get the local name Samuel, is not expected to directly affect the country’s weather, said the state weather bureau. Cempaka was maintaining its strength as it moved west-northwestward over the Philippine Sea, said the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) in its 11 p.m. advisory.
